First Appeared: Session 0
Status: Active
Affiliation: @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light}, @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}

Description

Lord of a minor but strategically placed county (@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.aHJXqousaIFYnECh]{Marrow County}) bordering the royal capital of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}.
Rules from Crest Aurelion, his castle in @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Aurelion}.
Often overshadowed politically, but deeply entwined with the Church.
He is a major donor, with several sons holding influential clerical positions.

Role

Marrow commissioned @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.6Eqkl1MNE1055IJC]{Edric Bloom} and the party to retrieve the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9OEpISjcWiYE6Gpe]{Seal of Unmaking} from @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tWj3TqwnEfJS9PQa]{Ashbrook}, describing it as a rare but otherwise unremarkable @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.pbvNoEuQV2PoM8wM]{Whiteglass} holy symbol.
In hindsight, the inclusion of a sealed metal container with warding locks — absent from his previous commissions — and the near total lack of information about the local populace made it clear he knew the relic's true nature.

According to @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin}, the Morrow family have been secret worshippers of renewal since @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold}'s founding.
Count Marrow has been searching his entire life for a way to release ruin so that renewal could return, continuing a family tradition stretching back generations.
Severin identified him as a herald of renewal — the missing piece needed to complete the puzzle and unlock the cocoon at the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Shrine of Renewal} beneath the Chryseum.

Methods

Those who cross Marrow are rarely punished openly.
Instead, sermons and homilies begin to reference their moral failings, and their reputations quietly erode until the common folk turn against them.
Such individuals soon find themselves unable to secure food, lodging, or meaningful aid.
Confronting Marrow is difficult due to his station, resources, and deep ties to the Church.

Collecting

Marrow keeps a collection of whiteglass artifacts in his private chambers at @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Crest Aurelion}.
He is a well-known collector of @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.pbvNoEuQV2PoM8wM]{Whiteglass} artifacts specifically — the translucent and radiant substance associated with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Lucifer}.
The expeditions he funds to retrieve whiteglass relics are normally precise and thoroughly documented.
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.6Eqkl1MNE1055IJC]{Edric Bloom} previously retrieved multiple whiteglass relics for Marrow on separate jobs, describing them as "curiosities at best."
@UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} theorized that each whiteglass artifact may have been a barrier holding ruin back, weakened one by one until the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9OEpISjcWiYE6Gpe]{Seal of Unmaking} was the final clasp.

Relationships

  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.6Eqkl1MNE1055IJC]{Edric Bloom} — Hired him to retrieve the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9OEpISjcWiYE6Gpe]{Seal of Unmaking}; previously hired him for multiple @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.pbvNoEuQV2PoM8wM]{Whiteglass} retrieval jobs
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.npwR0Fjaz34FwRrN]{Mayliss Vane} — His Assayer Sovereign; handles acquisitions and serves as gatekeeper
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{The Light} — Major donor; his son holds a ranking position in the Church, giving the Marrow family influence over the local church in @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.aHJXqousaIFYnECh]{Marrow County}
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.bEFUlWN5ttWk0y59]{Beaconhold} — Rules @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.aHJXqousaIFYnECh]{Marrow County}, a strategically placed border county
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Pom8bgcTgRw75seF]{The Triune} — Has an arrangement through @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.npwR0Fjaz34FwRrN]{Mayliss Vane} where they serve as magical consultants in exchange for autonomy

Key Events

  • Session 0 — Commissioned the party to retrieve the Seal of Unmaking from @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.tWj3TqwnEfJS9PQa]{Ashbrook}
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.QiQuaJOj62mEXbMZ]{Session 1} — The party decided not to return the Seal to him, suspecting his motives; they plan to bypass Marrow County on the way to Beacon Hold
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.jir5X1jFd08ME0H1]{Session 2} — The Harlequin Jimmy claimed both Marrow and the party are "puppets on the Laughing One's strings"; @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} suspects a conspiracy involving Marrow and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin}
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.YxfxYfYC1hm9ZNiA]{Session 4} — @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} revealed Marrow as a herald of renewal and the missing piece needed to unlock the cocoon; the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the Eclipsed Sword} arrived at Crest Aurelion to arrest him
  • @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.c5SHL7wB7yKbx7cP]{Session 5} — Retrieved from his private chambers at @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.E6jtdcGA7bfRGvuj]{Crest Aurelion} by @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.eNop3Y7Qd04NHq5f]{Garland} and @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.s4ABoIqxcgBnmTYz]{Roderic} during the @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.Iz0ZE5ZJtcXABZl7]{Order of the Eclipsed Sword}'s siege; reluctantly agreed to accompany them after being told ruin and renewal must be balanced; sealed the vault door to cover the party's escape; reunited with @UUID[Compendium.grimwild-kb.kb.JournalEntry.9r800oi2AazmBBPq]{Severin} in the tunnels; participated in the gathering of all six heralds that opened the cocoon
